scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, and every assigned screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; local rendering audit context was reviewed from the lane conventions and assignment/receipt files.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and complete ItemBody was visually reviewed in its snapshot/rendered tiles and compared with the byte-identical current source, assigned HTML, capture receipt, and screenshot tiles.
review_method.boundary: Local read-only review only. No network, builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, source edits, application edits, or publication-status changes. Only lane-06.md and lane-06.json were written.

findings.claim: Statement defines the reflections and product as plain prose tokens: “R_Π=2Π-I and R_Δ=2Δ-I, and U=R_ΠR_Δ”; the principal-phase expression also uses literal e^{iφ}.
findings.rendering: The original screenshot displays the underscores, braces, and operator formulas as ordinary text; the equations are not rendered as math. The following bound at line 38 is rendered, so this is a localized source-markup omission rather than a KaTeX failure.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the mathematical expressions on line 37 in inline math delimiters, preserving the existing operators and phase convention.

findings.claim: Statement uses plain ASCII math in “Ω(log n)”, “d×d”, “2^n≤(26d^(3/2))^(d^2)”, “d=2^q”, and “q=Ω(log n)”.
findings.rendering: In the original screenshot those expressions appear as ordinary text with caret exponents and unformatted subscripts rather than typeset mathematics. The corresponding Facts & Assumptions and proof use proper math delimiters, so this is a localized statement-formatting omission, not a renderer/receipt error.

diagram_review.existing_diagrams: No assigned ItemBody includes a rendered TikZ diagram; receipts report tikz_count 0 and diagram_failures 0 across the lane. Circuit and operator formulas in the opened tiles render legibly. No gate, wire, register, sign, index, or probability-label mismatch was confirmed in a rendered diagram.

candidates.claim: The truncated circuit omits every controlled phase CP_s whose denominator index s exceeds m, retains every Hadamard and all final reversal SWAPs, and is exact when m≥n.
candidates.concrete_content: An n-register wire diagram for a small n (for example n=4) with each Hadamard, controlled-phase gates labeled by denominator index s, omitted gates for s>m visually marked, and the final reversal SWAP sequence. Label wire order to match the declared ordered register. This is an uncertain editorial aid; the current procedure is explicit and no proof depends on a diagram.

candidates.claim: The reversible circuit acts as controlled multiplication on valid residues, as identity when control is zero or the input encoding is invalid, and returns all work to zero through a compute-copy-uncompute implementation.
candidates.concrete_content: A schematic register flow with control c, data z, clean n-bit target, and clean work: compute f_a(c,z) into target; copy/swap data and target with the specified three CNOTs per bit; uncompute the old-data target with f_{a^{-1}} using the new data; label the clean-work return and the identity cases. Keep the schematic at the block level rather than attempting to draw the full Boolean DAG. This is an uncertain editorial aid; the detailed finite DAG remains authoritative and no proof depends on a diagram.
